mapper.select: SELECT hist_sn::int AS "serial",asgn_chg_type_cd AS "type",aply_dt AS "date",new_ctrt_mm AS "mm",new_uprc AS "price",crct_yn AS "corrected",crct_trgt_sn::int AS "target" FROM tb_pj_asgn_hist WHERE asgn_id=#{id} ORDER BY aply_dt,hist_sn
SELECT input_ym AS "month",input_day_cnt::int AS "days",mon_mm AS "mm",aply_uprc AS "price",sales_amt AS "sales",fix_yn AS "fixed" FROM tb_pj_asgn_mon WHERE asgn_id=#{id} ORDER BY input_ym
SELECT std_val::bigint::text FROM tb_sy_oper_std WHERE std_cd='CASH_BASE_YM' ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT close_stat_cd FROM tb_cl_close WHERE close_ym=#{month}
mapper.update: LOCK TABLE tb_cl_close IN SHARE MODE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_pj_asgn_mon WHERE asgn_id=#{id} AND input_ym=#{month} AND fix_yn='N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_pj_asgn_mon(asgn_id,input_ym,dev_id,proj_id,input_day_cnt,mon_mm,aply_uprc,sales_amt,fix_yn,reg_user_id,reg_dttm) VALUES(#{source.id},#{month},#{source.developerId},#{source.projectId},#{value.inputDays},CAST(#{value.monthlyMm} AS numeric),CAST(#{value.appliedUnitPrice,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS numeric),CAST(#{value.salesAmount} AS numeric),'N',#{actor},#{now}) ON CONFLICT(asgn_id,input_ym) DO UPDATE SET input_day_cnt=EXCLUDED.input_day_cnt,mon_mm=EXCLUDED.mon_mm,aply_uprc=EXCLUDED.aply_uprc,sales_amt=EXCLUDED.sales_amt,mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=#{now} WHERE tb_pj_asgn_mon.fix_yn='N'
